claim_one_line: THE FRAMING LEDGER (the owner's exercise, 2026-11-03; OPEN, an audit): eighteen framing commitments of the programme inventoried from five readers' ~200 cited entries (docs/FRAMING_LEDGER.md) and ranked; the record had no inventory of its own framing. Computed data-free (two coarse facts of the measured world disclosed): the CKM's corner inversion is a construction choice (the Higgs's orientation from the adjoint units only, untwisted, shared) -- the mirror rule cannot lift it (0 of 303 nature-like points), a singlet Higgs component of the same sign in up and down does nothing (0.7-4.0%), the same singlet with OPPOSITE signs lifts it generically (33-47% at every phase against 2%; median |V_ub|/|V_td| about 0.9); on order-5 lines the frame is minimal SU(5) exactly (Y_u symmetric, the down and lepton spectra identical), so c = 3 is the Georgi-Jarlskog Clebsch by hand. About nine of the 19 have no frame (no action, normalisation or scale). Claims no parameter. 0 of 19.
